packageRules.description: Runtime dependencies ship to users; every bump gets read by a human.
Non-major dev dependencies: one PR a week, merged by the gate rather than by hand.
Major dev dependencies still automerge, but one at a time — a group is only as mergeable as its worst member.
Actions run with a token and are not dev dependencies. Digest-pinned, and merged deliberately.
The Node floor is stated in four places and they have drifted before, so they move in one PR: .nvmrc, engines.node, and both Dockerfile stages.

customManagers.description: ARG BEANS_VERSION is the only pin for the beans binary — the Dockerfile builds from it and CI reads it back out with sed, so nothing else may state a version. No manager covers an ARG, so this is the one place a bot can see it.
